detail: The design brief named the decide/record path, but override() posts the same entry_type "decision" mirror subject to the identical contradiction. The override outcome is fully preserved in the decision store (status overridden, overridden_by, override_reason) and is now reachable via the decision-store read paths.
summary: Removed the override() decision-type blackboard post along with decide()'s cross-post — both write entry_type "decision" mirrors that assemble filters out
